title: HiRoute: Hierarchical Routed Prompt Tuning for Safety Alignment of Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.12821v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to harmful requests and jailbreak attacks. Parameter-efficient safety alignment methods based on prompt tuning typically rely on a single global prompt or externally selected prompt modules. Such static designs struggle to maintain a cross-category safety boundary while generating constructive responses tailored to specific risks and avoiding over-refusal of benign inputs. To address these limitations, we propose HiRoute, an input-adaptive hierarchical prompt-tuning framework that separates category-agnostic safety control from category-specific response guidance. HiRoute first trains a lightweight hierarchical router on representations extracted from a frozen LLM to jointly detect harmful intent and predict multi-label risk scores. It then freezes both the backbone model and the router and uses preference optimization with alternating gradient updates to learn a shared coarse-grained prompt

translated_title: HiRoute：用于大型语言模型安全对齐的分层路由提示微调
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）仍然容易受到有害请求和越狱攻击的影响。基于提示微调的参数高效安全对齐方法通常依赖于单一的全局提示或外部选择的提示模块。这种静态设计难以在生成针对特定风险且避免过度拒绝良性输入的构建性响应的同时，维持跨类别的安全边界。为了解决这些限制，我们提出了HiRoute，一种输入自适应的分层提示微调框架，它将类别无关的安全控制与类别特定的响应指导分开。HiRoute首先在冻结的LLM提取的表示上训练一个轻量级分层路由器，以联合检测有害意图并预测多标签风险分数。然后，它冻结骨干模型和路由器，并使用带有交替梯度更新的偏好优化来学习一个共享的粗粒度提示。
tldr: HiRoute提出了一种输入自适应的分层提示微调框架，通过分离类别无关的安全控制和类别特定的响应指导，并利用轻量级分层路由器联合检测有害意图与预测多标签风险，从而在保持跨类别安全边界的同时避免过度拒绝良性输入。
en_tdlr: HiRoute proposes an input-adaptive hierarchical prompt-tuning framework that separates category-agnostic safety control from category-specific response guidance, using a lightweight hierarchical router to jointly detect harmful intent and predict multi-label risks, thereby maintaining cross-category safety boundaries while avoiding over-refusal of benign inputs.
